records.title: University of Eastern Finland Early Bird Discount (30%) and Tuition Waivers
records.deadline_display: To qualify for the Early Bird discount, students must accept their offer of admission and pay the tuition fee, or the first instalment of the tuition fee, by the deadline stated in the admission letter (usually 21 days of the publication of the admission results).

source.as_of: Page section 'Tuition waivers for 2027 intake', page notes 'Updated on 3 August 2026.'
source.raw_extract:
First academic year (Early Bird discount): To qualify for the Early Bird discount, students must accept their offer of admission and pay the tuition fee, or the first instalment of the tuition fee, by the deadline stated in the admission letter (usually 21 days of the publication of the admission results). If the fee is paid in two equal instalments, the second instalment must be paid by 31 August.

To qualify for the discount, students must accept their offer of admission and pay the tuition fee, or the first instalment of the fee, within 21 days of the publication of the admission results. Detailed payment instructions and the applicable payment deadline will be provided in the admission letter.

Second and subsequent years: The annual tuition fee must be paid by 31 August, either as a single payment or in two equal instalments.
source.exact_deadline_wording: by the deadline stated in the admission letter (usually 21 days of the publication of the admission results)
source.notes: The official page publishes no fixed calendar application deadline for this award. The Early Bird discount is not applied for on a published date: it is triggered by accepting the admission offer and paying within a window that UEF states per admission letter. The only fixed day-month on the page is '31 August', which applies to (a) the second instalment of the first year's tuition fee and (b) the annual tuition fee in second and subsequent years - both are payment obligations, not an application deadline for the award, and neither carries a year, so no date could be written even if it were treated as the deadline. The second/third-year tuition waiver is awarded on academic progress with 'A separate application period is organized after the first year of studies' and no dates published, so no application deadline exists for that part either. Returned as UNKNOWN rather than guessing a date from the Finnish national application cycle, which would be an inference from a different programme. A maintainer who wants to model this record as a recurring 31 August payment obligation can do so from the verbatim quotes above, but that is a modelling choice, not a published application deadline.

field_mapping.deadline_display: No published calendar deadline. Early Bird discount: pay by 'the deadline stated in the admission letter (usually 21 days of the publication of the admission results)'. Tuition fee: 'The annual tuition fee must be paid by 31 August' (no year stated).

records.title: UNHCR Tertiary Refugee Scholarship Programme (DAFI) - Albert Einstein German Academic Refugee Initiative
records.deadline_display: Applications will be accepted from 15 July to 7 August 2026. Please note that late applications will not be considered. (UNHCR Rwanda country-operation call for the 2026/2027 academic year; deadlines are set per country operation, not globally)

source.publisher: UNHCR Rwanda Country Operation (UNHCR Help portal, help.unhcr.org)
source.as_of: Call for the 2026/2027 academic year, published 15 July 2026; page carries 'Information printed on: 2026-10-05 15:32:57'
source.raw_extract:
UNHCR's Tertiary Refugee Scholarship Programme (DAFI) offers qualified refugee and returnee (in selected countries*) students the possibility to earn an undergraduate degree in their country of asylum or home country. The scholarship package varies from country to country and covers a range of costs including tuition and study materials, food, transportation, and accommodation.

Timeframe:
Applications will be accepted from 15 July to 7 August 2026. Please note that late applications will not be considered.

Applications are now open for the 2026/2027 academic year, and eligible refugees and asylum-seekers are invited to apply by 7 August 2026.
source.exact_deadline_wording: Applications will be accepted from 15 July to 7 August 2026.
source.notes: DAFI is a global programme with no single global deadline: each UNHCR country operation runs its own call and publishes its own window. The record's official_source_url (the DAFI Programme Management Platform page) was fetched but is JavaScript-gated and publishes no deadline text; the platform itself lists only per-country rounds. Two official UNHCR country pages were fetched and they show different deadlines for the same 2026/2027 cycle - Rwanda 'Applications will be accepted from 15 July to 7 August 2026' (https://help.unhcr.org/rwanda/2026/07/15/call-for-application-for-dafi-scholarship-programme-for-academic-year-2026-2027/) and Slovakia 'The call for applications for DAFI scholarships for the 2026/2027 academic year is now CLOSED.' (https://help.unhcr.org/slovakia/education/dafi-scholarship-programme/). Per brief section 6, different country calls having different deadlines is NOT a conflict, so CONFLICTING was not used. Because the record is programme-wide and no single date applies, deadline_date is null and precision stays unknown; a country-specific record would be needed to carry a date. All 2026/2027 country calls were already closed as of 2026-10-05, but new country calls are announced per country and no future global date was published, so nothing was inferred or rolled forward.

field_mapping.deadline_display: No global deadline is published. Deadlines are set and published per UNHCR country operation (2026/2027 cycle examples: Rwanda 15 July - 7 August 2026; Slovakia call closed). Applicants must check their own country operation's call and apply through the DAFI Programme Management Platform.
